c74object.name: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
c74object.digest: Coefficients calculator for polyphase IIR halfband allpass quadrature hilbert filter cascade, outputs messages, dict and buffer~ arrays
c74object.description: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs wraps js code that implements the Laurent de Soras HIIR library. Using this library we can calculate filter coefficients for high quality polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascades. In evieve the filter cascades are realised in standard evieve GenExpr code (evi.hilbert~ and evi.freqshift.hilbert~).

outlet.digest: coefficients in format set by the @iterate attribute.
outlet.description: If @iterate = 0, the word 'coeffs' followed by a list of coefficients. If @iterate = 1 (default), the word 'coeffN' repeatedly, where 'N' is the coefficient number, followed by a single coefficient.

outlet.digest: individual coefficients or dictionary data depending on 'peek' and 'dict' messages to the object
outlet.description: Receive query reults from internal [buffer~] and [dict].

objarg.name: Data name
objarg.description: The name of the internal data structures (buffer~ and dict). By default this is a unique name. Give your own name here if you want to access the data in other data objects in your patcher. Either way you can still query all internal data and utilise the dumpout outlet.

objarg.name: Number of coefficients
objarg.description: Set the number of coefficients to create, 2..64, default 8 (for evieve Hilbert). Does not technically recompute coefficients, but coefficients are computed on load.

objarg.name: Transition bandwidth
objarg.description: Set the filter transition bandwidth to use in Hz, default 40, 4..samplerate*0.25. Does not technically recompute coefficients, but coefficients are computed on load.

method.name: bang
method.digest: In left inlet, bang message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs

method.name: int
method.digest: In left inlet, int message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: (int) Set the number of coefficients to create, 2..64, default 8 (for evieve Hilbert). Does not recompute coefficients.

method.name: float
method.digest: In left inlet, float message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: (float) Set the filter transition bandwidth to use in Hz, default 40, 4..samplerate*0.25. Does not recompute coefficients.

method.name: sr
method.digest: In left inlet, sr message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: The word 'sr' will (re)grab the current samplerate and recalculate and output the coefficients.

method.name: buffer
method.digest: In left inlet, buffer message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: The word 'buffer' followed by a 'write' message: write, writeaiff, writeflac, writeraw, writewave, will write the contents of the internal coefficients [buffer~] to a file.

method.name: peek
method.digest: In left inlet, peek message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: The word 'peek' followed by an integer representing an index of the internal [buffer~] will output the corresponding coefficient as a float from the far right dumpout outlet.

method.name: dict
method.digest: In left inlet, dict message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: The word 'dict' followed by a message that [dict] understands (excluding clear, import, read, readagain, readany) will send the message to the internal [dict] object. Query results are available at the far right dumpout outlet.

method.name: view
method.digest: In left inlet, view message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
method.description: The word 'view' will open the editing windows of the internal [dict] and [buffer~] objects to view their contents.

attribute.name: iterate
attribute.description: 0 = output coefficients as list (Max), 1 = output coefficients iteratively one by one (gen~)
